clips.title: The story
paras: Grim Batol's gates remain sealed above the eastern Wetlands. The Wildhammer dwarves abandoned the fortress after a curse during the War of the Three Hammers, and the Dragonmaw orcs later used it as a dragon-breeding lair.

Thane Khardros Wildhammer carved Grim Batol from the jagged mountains east of the marsh after the ancient civil war among the three clans. During the War of the Three Hammers, the Dark Iron sorceress Modgud laid siege to the fortress. Khardros struck her down, but before she died, Modgud cast a foul shadow across its stones. The lingering taint made the halls uninhabitable, and the surviving Wildhammer dwarves abandoned their kingdom and migrated north into the Hinterlands.

During the Second War, Orgrim Doomhammer sent the Dragonmaw clan to claim Grim Batol. The warlock Nekros Skullcrusher led the orcs, who used the ancient artifact called the Demon Soul to enslave the red Dragonqueen Alexstrasza deep beneath the mountain. Chained there, Alexstrasza was forced to hatch broods for the Horde's war effort until a small band of heroes shattered the artifact. Freed, the enraged Dragon Aspect incinerated the orcs within. Grim Batol was left a desolate ruin, watched closely by surviving red dragons.
